summary_points.text: The project manager recapped the kick-off meeting and put its minutes in the project folder
Three new requirements: no teletext, the remote only controls the television, and the corporate colour and slogan must be in the design
The project manager assigned work for after lunch: components concept, user interface and trend watching
The team agreed to group the remote's functions into the three categories proposed by the industrial designer

decisions.text: The remote will not include teletext
The remote will only control the television, not a VCR, DVD or other devices
The corporate colour and slogan will be incorporated into the design of the remote
The team will use the three function categories (buckets) proposed by the industrial designer
